title: FBI hacked? ShinyHunters claims brazen theft of sensitive agent data — what the cybercriminal group wants
snippet: ShinyHunters claims it breached the FBI and stole sensitive data belonging to agents and job applicants. The hacker group says it accessed terabytes of information through an Oracle PeopleSoft server and an Amazon-hosted government cloud.

title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max launched: Triple 200MP cameras, 8,000mAh battery, price and specs
snippet: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max launched in China with triple 200MP cameras, an 8,000mAh battery, the Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, and a 6.78-inch 144Hz display. India launch expected around Diwali/end-October 2026; local pricing not announced.

title: Vivo V80 India launch date: 5 key features to know before you buy
snippet: Vivo V80 launches in India on October 6 with a ZEISS quad-camera system, 50MP main and telephoto sensors, a 6.59-inch 144Hz 1.5K OLED display, a 7,200mAh battery with 90W fast charging, and OriginOS 7 with 30+ AI camera features. Price to be revealed at launch.
